If a submission is rejected, return to step 2 and update the same task file.

Replace a previous task file only with a candidate that reproduces every pair exactly; if no candidate does, leave the previous file unchanged. Then use `finish`. mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-1d607ee2.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    # The outer 3 frame is fixed; the sole interior 3 marks the center of the pattern.
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    center = [(r, c) for r, c in points if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    cr, cc = center[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = max(abs(r - cr), abs(c - cc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
    return out
PY
